label: Luggage Tag
description: Travel tag with your name and phone, plus a strap slot.

line2.label: Line 2
line2.help: A second line. Leave blank for one line.

emboss.label: Raised text
emboss.help: 1 = text sticks out of the surface, 0 = text is cut into it. Raised text is easier to print and to colour differently.

th.label: Thickness
th.help: How thick the plate is. 3–4 mm is sturdy for a tag or keychain.

corner_r.label: Corner rounding
corner_r.help: How rounded the corners are. 0 gives sharp corners.

slot_w.label: Cable slot width
slot_w.help: Gap for a charging cable to pass through.

slot_h.label: Strap slot width
slot_h.help: Thickness of the slot the strap threads through.

slot_zone.label: Strap slot area
slot_zone.help: Space reserved at the end for the strap slot.

text_size.label: Max text size
text_size.help: Cap on letter height. Text is shrunk automatically if it doesn't fit, so this is a maximum, not a fixed size.

line_gap.label: Line spacing
line_gap.help: Vertical gap between lines. Reduced automatically if the lines won't fit.

text_height.label: Text height
text_height.help: How far the letters stick out (or how deep they're cut). About 1 mm is plenty.
